thread:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Incident opened - region asia-east1 - GPU pool reporting quota throttle, autoscaler cannot provision. Avg queue growth +240 req/min in last 5m. PagerDuty alert fired to oncall.

sara: I'm on it, seeing autoscaler logs showing 403 quota errors from GCP. link: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas?project=redwood-prod

priya: Customer-facing: support dashboard shows a spike of 5xxs for multi-tenant region customers (esp tenant: acme-corp). Latency up ~700ms, error rate ~12% for generation requests.

mike: Confirming: modest spike, but quota error appears when scaler tries to create `nvidia-t4` instances. GCP returns `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` / `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`.

tom: Can we failover traffic to us-central1 or eu-west1 for critical requests? We have capacity in us-central1. How quickly to flip?

sara: Two-pronged: short-term redirect critical routes to us-central1 ramp (canary) + immediate mitigation to free local capacity: kill non-critical batch jobs, reduce concurrency for best-effort customers, and request emergency quota bump.

liu: I'm on the quota request. Submitted support case 2026-03-15-342 with priority=critical. GCP issued case id GCP-87645 and says they'll review; not guaranteed within minutes.

priya: Can we enable fallback model (cpu-quant) for non-critical requests to reduce GPU usage? That will increase latency but reduce GPU pressure.

mike: Yes, we have a smaller cpu-backed serving path. Config snippet to toggle route:```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "selector": "tier==best-effort",
  "fallback_model": "redwood/cpu-quant-v1",
  "ttl": "10m"
}
``` apply via console or API.

tom: I'm taking over primary oncall for handoff. @sara handing to @tom at 03:27 UTC. tom:ack :white_check_mark: 

sara: quick notes: autoscaler log excerpt showing error:```text
2026-03-15T03:20:12Z ERROR provisioner: failed to create instance: googleapi: Error 403: Quota exceeded for region asia-east1.
``` we also saw sustained queue growth in worker-queue: `pending_messages=1842` up from 320 in 4m.

support-bot: #customers_impacted: 9 (high-traffic tenants), top impacted: acme-corp (22% of their requests failed), quickstart-saas (6% errors).

tom: Actions I'll run now: 1) set routing rule to prefer us-central1 for critical routes (canary 10% -> 100% if stable), 2) scale down batch pool (label batch=true) from 40 -> 8, 3) enable cpu fallback for best-effort. Running step 1.

mike: For step 2 run:```bash
kubectl scale deployment batch-worker -n prod --replicas=8 -l tier=batch
``` and cordon GPU nodes used by batch jobs? We should avoid draining all at once.

tom: Doing scale now... scaled. K8s reports: 32 pods terminated, GC in progress. Node utilization free = ~40% after scale.

liu: Quota request update: GCP acknowledged urgency: "We can expedite but need justification + traffic data". I uploaded request logs and a short justification doc.

priya: Noting customer comms: we're drafting a status line for affected customers. Short: "Experiencing elevated errors in asia-east1; mitigation underway. Some requests may be routed to other regions."

tom: Routed critical traffic 10% to us-central1 canary, monitoring. If error rate drops under 2% in 3m, increase to 50%.

infra-bot: Autoscaler events (summary): create_attempts=18, create_failures=18 (403 QUOTA_EXCEEDED), provisioned_since_alert=0.

sara: Reminder: preserve affinity for tenants with data residency requirements. Do not shift those customers. We only route tenants without residency locks.

mike: After scaling down batch pool and enabling cpu fallback for best-effort, GPU pool utilization dropped from 98% -> 74%. Queue growth rate slowed to +20 req/min. Good signal.

priya: Support update ready. I'll send to top 9 customers with high impact and post status page update. Draft: "We are mitigating a quota-related GPU provisioning issue in asia-east1. Traffic will be routed to alternate regions where possible. Some requests may be slower or routed. Engineers are working on a permanent quota resolution."

tom: Increasing canary to 50% for critical routes. Monitoring logs/metrics.

support-bot: Customer impact metric window (5m): total requests=12,342, errors=1,483 (12.0%), affected_customers=9.

liu: GCP response: support case updated - "We've placed a temporary quota exception for project redwood-prod in asia-east1 for 2 hours while we validate." ETA ~14 minutes.

mike: If exception holds, autoscaler should be able to provision the queued nodes. We'll watch create_success events.

infra-bot: New autoscaler event: create_success=6 (instances provisioned), pending_messages down to 732.

priya: Support: first customer ack: acme-corp support says errors reduced but still seeing intermittent timeouts. Sending them the routing timeframe.

tom: Keeping this P1 but reducing noise. I'm running a controlled rollback if the quota exception is revoked. Also opening a follow-up ticket to add proactive quota monitoring and alert rule.

sara: Thanks @tom @mike @liu for quick work. I'll update the oncall rota notes and follow up with a retrospective tomorrow.

pagerduty: incident acknowledged by tom at 03:27 UTC. Incident status: mitigation in progress.

tom: I'm going to step down from primary in 40m. Leaving post-incident actions: 1) permanent quota increase request, 2) add autoscaler backoff/retry jitter, 3) routing guardrails for residency, 4) add pre-provisioning check to ramp before batch windows.

mike: Logging commands used for postmortem:```bash
gcloud compute operations list --filter="region:asia-east1 AND status=DONE" --project=redwood-prod
kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide | grep batch-worker
```

support-bot: Posted status page update and customer emails sent.

tom: we'll keep thread open until quota exception expires and queue fully drained. Current metrics: pending_messages=210, error_rate=1.8%, GPU_util=62%.

sara: handing back to next oncall (sara) at 04:10 UTC for post-incident cleanup. :white_check_mark: 

pagerduty: incident resolved? not resolved; monitoring continues. manual close pending postmortem.

liu: Noted for postmortem: root cause: regional quota soft limit + batch job spike during maintenance window. Action items created in JIRA: RED-3421 (quota permanent increase), RED-3422 (pre-provision check), RED-3423 (routing residency guardrail).

priya: I'll prep customer summary and timeline for the postmortem doc.

support-bot: Thread archived when incident moved to monitoring.
